text: {"features":[{"evidence":"Bachelor's / Master's / Doctoral degree in computer science","name":"academic qualification","description":"Captures how far the letter exceeds the role's educational baseline and how clearly the education is aligned with the job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No relevant degree is stated, or the educational background is unclear or weakly related."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States a relevant Bachelor's degree or equivalent baseline preparation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a relevant Master's degree, signaling stronger formal preparation than the minimum."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"States a relevant Doctoral degree or similarly advanced research training."}]},{"evidence":"3, 5, or 7 years testing, maintaining, and launching production services","name":"professional software tenure","description":"Captures the amount of directly relevant software engineering experience the letter claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Experience is below the job baseline, unclear, or not tied to real software product work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows roughly minimum-level experience, such as about 2 to 3 years of relevant software engineering."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-level experience, such as about 4 to 5 years of relevant work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive relevant experience, such as 6 or more years building and maintaining production software."}]},{"evidence":"launch of 2, 4, or 6 production services","name":"production delivery breadth","description":"Captures how much concrete evidence the letter gives of shipping and operating multiple real services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides little or no concrete evidence of shipping production systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows limited but real delivery scope, such as responsibility for 1 to 2 production services or vague launch ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows moderate delivery breadth, such as work across 3 to 4 production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows broad delivery breadth, such as 5 or more production services with testing, maintenance, and launch responsibility."}]},{"evidence":"Go is my principal programming language","name":"Go depth","description":"Captures whether the letter makes Go a central, credible strength rather than a passing mention.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Go is absent or too vague to judge."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Go is mentioned, but the letter does not establish it as a major working language."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular professional use of Go in relevant systems work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly presents Go as a primary language backed by shipped backend or infrastructure work."}]},{"evidence":"Python became my workhorse / use Python daily","name":"Python depth","description":"Captures the strength of Python experience relevant to tooling, automation, and AI-agent work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Python is absent or not evidenced."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Python is mentioned lightly, with limited sense of depth or production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular Python use for tooling, services, or automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as a central, production-grade language used broadly across tooling, services, and automation or agents."}]},{"evidence":"built and shipped LLM-based features / evaluation practices","name":"applied AI experience","description":"Captures whether the letter shows practical experience deploying AI systems and understanding their reliability requirements.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No meaningful AI experience is shown."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure, but without strong evidence of production application."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows concrete experience building or shipping AI or LLM-backed functionality in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience plus explicit attention to evaluation, hardening, trustworthiness, or failure-mode management."}]},{"evidence":"architected agentic tooling with Go back-end and Python agents","name":"agentic systems design","description":"Captures experience designing bounded agent-based systems rather than merely mentioning AI.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No agentic or autonomous-system design experience is shown."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Agents are mentioned vaguely, without clear design ownership or system detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows real design or implementation of agent-based workflows or tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end agentic architecture with explicit control mechanisms such as guardrails, permissions, auditing, or a clear Go/Python split."}]},{"evidence":"conducted formal security assessments / threat modeling / code review","name":"security assessment practice","description":"Captures evidence of performing substantive security reviews rather than only being security-adjacent.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No concrete security assessment work is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows general security interest but little direct evidence of assessment practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows concrete assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, or design review."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows repeated, hands-on security assessment work with clear methods, findings, or remediation follow-through."}]},{"evidence":"automated vulnerability report triage / intake and routing","name":"vulnerability handling automation","description":"Captures direct experience turning vulnerability-report processing into software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No experience with vulnerability handling automation is shown."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in security automation, but without a concrete vulnerability-processing example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Claims specific experience automating vulnerability intake or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes detailed vulnerability automation such as classification, deduplication, routing, prioritization, or measurable workload reduction."}]},{"evidence":"data structures and algorithms ... redesigning a lookup service / matching algorithm","name":"algorithmic depth","description":"Captures whether the letter demonstrates strong practical problem-solving with data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No meaningful evidence of algorithmic strength is provided."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes a generic claim about data structures or algorithms without much support."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of improving a real system through algorithmic or data-structure choices."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows vivid, credible algorithmic fluency through strong examples on hard bottlenecks, hot paths, or system redesigns."}]},{"evidence":"typed, tested services / clear contracts / audit their actions","name":"engineering rigor","description":"Captures emphasis on constraints, correctness, auditability, testing, and craftsmanship in security-sensitive systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Little evidence of a rigor-oriented engineering mindset appears in the letter."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter gestures at reliability or quality, but mostly at a high level."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides concrete rigor signals such as typed and tested tooling, explicit contracts, or boundary enforcement."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently frames work in terms of high standards, auditability, constraints, correctness, and dependable operation."}]},{"evidence":"OSCP / Security+","name":"formal security credential","description":"Captures whether the letter offers external validation of security knowledge or offensive skill.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No security credential is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a baseline credential such as Security+ that supports general security grounding."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions a stronger hands-on credential such as OSCP that signals practical offensive skill."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows unusually strong credential evidence, such as multiple relevant credentials or a strong credential explained as direct proof of practical capability."}]},{"evidence":"capture-the-flag competitions","name":"active adversarial practice","description":"Captures whether the letter shows ongoing hands-on offensive security practice beyond day-job claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No adversarial or offensive-security practice is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional CTF participation or informal attacker-minded practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular, intentional participation in CTFs or similar offensive practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong competitive commitment, such as near-top finishes or repeated high-level participation."}]},{"evidence":"submit patches upstream / maintain an open-source project","name":"open-source engagement","description":"Captures external engineering contribution through fixing, maintaining, or leading software used beyond the applicant's own team.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No open-source contribution is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patches or minor upstream fixes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular contribution or maintenance of a small public project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful open-source leadership, such as maintaining an active project or widely used library with review, release, or community responsibility."}]},{"evidence":"distributed task queue / replicated cache / small habit tracker","name":"personal systems project ambition","description":"Captures the technical ambition and seriousness of self-directed projects described outside core job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No personal project is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a small utility or simple app with limited technical depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a meaningful standalone project with moderate systems or engineering complexity."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a substantial personal systems project tackling hard concerns such as distributed state, failover, consistency, storage, or recovery."}]},{"evidence":"scale scarce security judgment / variant analysis / reduce manual toil","name":"security automation thesis","description":"Captures how well the letter understands the specific problem this team solves: multiplying security expertise through automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only generic interest in security without a clear automation thesis."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions automation or reducing toil, but only in broad terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly frames the role as scaling security work through systems and automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates a nuanced view of the problem, such as variant analysis, capacity multiplication, principled workflow design, or scarce-expert scaling."}]},{"evidence":"foundational infrastructure ... inherited by every team downstream","name":"platform leverage mindset","description":"Captures orientation toward central tooling whose benefits compound across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No real platform or foundational framing is present."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows general interest in scale or impact, but not clearly in central platform work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly values central tooling, foundational infrastructure, or multiplier effects across teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a strong platform-team mentality, including explicit multiplier-effect reasoning and respect for downstream builders."}]},{"evidence":"make the secure path the easy path / close to the people it serves","name":"developer service orientation","description":"Captures whether the letter frames security tooling as a service to developers rather than as policing or process.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little about the developers who will use the tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses a general desire to help teams, but without much user-centered detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes reducing friction, making secure defaults easy, or serving developer workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows vivid developer empathy through language about proximity to users, removing friction, and building tools people actually want to use."}]},{"evidence":"Google treats security as an engineering discipline / Google's internal ecosystem / inside Core","name":"organization-specific motivation","description":"Captures how specifically the letter ties the applicant's motivation to Google, this team, or Google's security context rather than to any security job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Could be sent to almost any employer, with no clear Google-specific rationale."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows generic attraction to Google's scale, brand, or security work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects motivation to Google-specific context such as security culture, internal scale, or the Core setting."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced understanding of why this Google team is a particularly strong fit for the applicant's background and priorities."}]},{"evidence":"measured its worth in the hours returned / deduplicating findings / exactly-once semantics","name":"specificity of supporting evidence","description":"Captures how concretely the letter substantiates claims with examples, mechanisms, metrics, or outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on generic assertions with little supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides some concrete examples, but support is limited or uneven."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides multiple specific examples tied to mechanisms, ownership, or outcomes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides especially vivid, quantified, or causally explained evidence that makes the claims highly credible."}]},{"evidence":"The moment that shaped my engineering priorities ... / Every security team I have seen ...","name":"narrative distinctiveness","description":"Captures whether the letter has a memorable, coherent point of view rather than reading like a checklist.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as formulaic or checklist-like, with little distinctive voice or structure."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some personalization, but the overall letter still feels mostly list-based."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a clear organizing story, principle, or perspective that ties the letter together."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Delivers a strong, memorable through-line that makes the application feel unusually coherent and distinctive."}]},{"evidence":"taem / prduction / gnireenignE","name":"writing polish","description":"Captures the level of proofreading and surface professionalism shown by spelling, grammar, and clean presentation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent distracting errors or awkwardness undermine professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several noticeable errors appear, though the meaning remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mostly clean and readable, with only minor slips."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Polished, proofread, and professional throughout."}]}]}
